title.en: Tuesday Homework: Weather Review (W1 to W4)
title.zh: 星期二作业：天气复习（W1 到 W4）

intro.en: Look at your Main Book if you need to. One try only.
intro.zh: 需要的话看主课本。只能做一次。

questions.q: Your outfit today is like weather. Your whole wardrobe is like...

why.en: Climate = the usual weather over many years, like everything in your wardrobe.
why.zh: 气候 = 很多年来通常的天气，就像整个衣柜。

questions.q: Weather happens in the lowest layer of the atmosphere, called the...

why.en: Clouds, rain and wind are all in the troposphere.
why.zh: 云、雨和风都在对流层。

questions.q: An air mass that formed over cold land in winter is...

why.en: Over land = continental (dry). Cold = polar.
why.zh: 在陆地上 = continental（干）。冷 = polar。

questions.q: Maritime means the air mass formed over...

why.en: Maritime = the sponge sat over the ocean, so it is wet.
why.zh: maritime = 海绵在海上，所以是湿的。

questions.q: Warm air is light, so it...

why.en: Warm air rises, like a hot air balloon.
why.zh: 暖空气上升，就像热气球。

questions.q: A front is...
options: where two different air masses meet

why.en: A front is the front line of a moving air mass, where it meets another one.
why.zh: 锋是移动气团的前沿，是两个气团相遇的地方。

questions.q: On a weather map, a line with blue triangles is a...

why.en: Blue triangles = cold front. Red half circles = warm front.
why.zh: 蓝色三角形 = 冷锋。红色半圆 = 暖锋。

questions.q: A front that stays in one place for days, like a tug of war where nobody wins, is a...

why.en: Stationary = not moving, so the same rainy weather stays for days.
why.zh: 静止 = 不移动，所以同样的雨天会持续好几天。

questions.q: Rain, snow, sleet and hail are all kinds of...

why.en: Precipitation = any water that falls from clouds.
why.zh: 降水 = 从云里落下来的任何水。

questions.q: A tall thunderstorm cloud is a...

why.en: Cumulus (puffy) + nimbus (rain) = a tall thunderstorm cloud.
why.zh: cumulus（蓬松）+ nimbus（雨）= 高高的雷雨云。

canNow.en: I can now remember air masses, fronts and clouds.
canNow.zh: 我现在记得气团、锋和云。

title.zh: 星期三作业：方程（M1 和 M2）

intro.en: Look at your Main Book if you need to. One try only.
intro.zh: 需要的话看主课本。只能做一次。

questions.q: Solve 8n = 56.

why.en: n is multiplied by 8, so divide both sides by 8: 56 ÷ 8 = 7. Check: 8 × 7 = 56 ✓

questions.q: Solve k ÷ 4 = 9.

why.en: k is divided by 4, so multiply both sides by 4: 9 × 4 = 36. Check: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 ✓

questions.q: To solve 6m = 42, what do you do to both sides?

why.en: 6m means 6 × m. The opposite of × is ÷, so divide both sides by 6.
why.zh: 6m 是 6 × m。× 的相反是 ÷，所以两边除以 6。

questions.q: Solve 12 = 3p.

why.en: Divide both sides by 3: 12 ÷ 3 = 4. Check: 3 × 4 = 12 ✓

questions.q: Solve y ÷ 5 = 7.

why.en: Multiply both sides by 5: 7 × 5 = 35. Check: 35 ÷ 5 = 7 ✓

questions.q: 2/3 x = 10. What is x?

why.en: 2 parts = 10, so 1 part = 10 ÷ 2 = 5. x is all 3 parts: 3 × 5 = 15. Check: 2/3 × 15 = 30/3 = 10 ✓

questions.q: 3/4 m = 18. One part (1/4 of m) is...

why.en: 3 parts = 18, so 1 part = 18 ÷ 3 = 6.

questions.q: 3/4 m = 18. What is m?
Sophie spent 2/5 of her money. That was $8. How much money did she have at the start?
James ran 5/6 of a race. That was 10 km. Which equation matches? (r = the whole race)

why.en: 5/6 of the whole race (5/6 × r) is 10 km. Then r = 12 km.
why.zh: 整个比赛的 5/6（5/6 × r）是 10 千米。所以 r = 12 千米。

canNow.en: I can now solve × and ÷ equations and fraction equations.
canNow.zh: 我现在会解乘除方程和分数方程。

title.en: Thursday Homework: Usage, Proofreading and Flyers (E1 to E3)
title.zh: 星期四作业：用法、校对和宣传单（E1 到 E3）

intro.en: Look at your Main Book if you need to. One try only.
intro.zh: 需要的话看主课本。只能做一次。

questions.q: There were ___ people at the fair this year.

why.en: People can be counted, so use FEWER.
why.zh: 人可以数，所以用 FEWER。

questions.q: Emma is taller ___ Tom.

why.en: THAN compares two things.
why.zh: THAN 用来比较两样东西。

questions.q: Everyone went to the beach ___ James.

why.en: EXCEPT means "but not": everyone but James.
why.zh: EXCEPT 意思是“除了”：除了 James 以外的所有人。

questions.q: ___ going to the science fair?

why.en: Say it in full: Who is going? So write WHO'S.
why.zh: 说完整：Who is going? 所以写 WHO'S。

questions.q: The dog wagged ___ tail.

why.en: "It is tail" makes no sense, so write ITS (belongs to it).
why.zh: “It is tail” 说不通，所以写 ITS（它的）。

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: I should have brought a hat.
I should of brought a hat.

why.en: Never write "should of". Write SHOULD HAVE.
why.zh: 不要写 "should of"，要写 SHOULD HAVE。

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: We are all ready to go.

why.en: ALL READY = everyone is ready. ALREADY = before now.
why.zh: ALL READY = 大家都准备好了。ALREADY = 已经。

questions.q: Our coach will ___ us how to dive.

why.en: TEACH = show someone else how. The coach shows us.
why.zh: TEACH = 教别人。教练教我们。

questions.q: A flyer must tell people what, when, where and...

why.en: What, when, where and the activities, so people want to come.
why.zh: 什么活动、什么时候、在哪里、有哪些项目，让人想来参加。

questions.q: Which flyer line is a call to action?
options: Bring a friend and join the fun!
The fair was planned in May.

why.en: A call to action tells the reader what to do.
why.zh: 行动号召告诉读者要做什么。

canNow.en: I can now choose the right usage words and plan a flyer.
canNow.zh: 我现在能选对用法词，也会计划宣传单。

intro.en: Read the word, say what it means, then tap to check.
intro.zh: 读词，说出意思，再点卡片检查。

cards.back: How hard the air pushes down on Earth.
cards.zhBack: 空气向地面压下来的力量。

cards.back: Heavy, cold air sinks. Usually clear, sunny skies.
cards.zhBack: 又重又冷的空气下沉。通常是晴天。

cards.back: Light, warm air rises. Usually clouds and rain.
cards.zhBack: 又轻又暖的空气上升。通常有云和雨。

cards.back: Air moving from HIGH pressure to LOW pressure.
A line on a weather map joining places with the same air pressure.
cards.zhBack: 天气图上连接气压相同地方的线。

cards.back: One small symbol showing all the weather at one place: a weather selfie.
cards.zhBack: 用一个小符号表示一个地方的所有天气：天气自拍。

cards.back: How much of the sky is covered by cloud. The circle on a station model.
cards.zhBack: 天空被云遮住了多少。气象站模型中间的圆圈。

cards.back: Many station models together, with H, L, fronts and isobars: the group photo.
cards.zhBack: 很多气象站模型放在一起，还有 H、L、锋和等压线：大合照。

cards.back: How much water vapour is in the air.
How FULL the air is of water vapour, as a percent (%).
cards.zhBack: 空气装了多满的水蒸气，用百分比（%）表示。

cards.back: Water drops on grass in the early morning, from water vapour that condensed.
cards.zhBack: 清晨草上的水珠，是水蒸气凝结成的。

cards.back: The temperature where the air is full and water vapour turns into drops.
cards.zhBack: 空气装满、水蒸气开始变成水珠时的温度。

canNow.en: I can now explain 12 more weather words.
canNow.zh: 我现在能再解释 12 个天气词汇。

title.zh: 天气配对游戏（W5 到 W7）

intro.en: Tap a word, then tap its meaning.

canNow.en: I can now match pressure, wind and humidity words.
canNow.zh: 我现在能配对气压、风和湿度的词。

intro.en: Remember the pictures: the squeezed balloon, the weather selfie and the full sponge.
intro.zh: 记住这些画面：被挤的气球、天气自拍和装满的海绵。

questions.q: Air pressure is...
options: how hard the air pushes down on Earth

why.en: Air pressure = the push of the air on Earth.
why.zh: 气压 = 空气对地面的压力。

questions.q: Low pressure usually brings...

why.en: Light warm air rises, cools and makes clouds and rain.
why.zh: 轻的暖空气上升、变冷，形成云和雨。

questions.q: Wind blows from...
options: warm places to cold places only

why.en: Like air rushing out of a squeezed balloon: from high to low.
why.zh: 就像被挤的气球里冲出来的空气：从高到低。

questions.q: Lines on a weather map that join places with the same air pressure are...

why.en: Isobar = same pressure line.
why.zh: 等压线 = 气压相同的线。

questions.q: Isobars far apart mean...

why.en: Close lines = strong wind. Far apart = gentle wind.
why.zh: 线靠得近 = 大风。离得远 = 微风。

questions.q: A station model is like a weather...

why.en: One station, one symbol: a weather selfie.
why.zh: 一个气象站，一个符号：天气自拍。

questions.q: On a station model, the number on the LEFT is the...

why.en: Left = temperature. Right = air pressure.
why.zh: 左边 = 温度。右边 = 气压。

questions.q: On a station model, the feathers on the stick show...

why.en: The stick shows wind direction. The feathers show wind speed.
why.zh: 线（杆）表示风向，羽毛表示风速。

questions.q: Relative humidity tells how ___ the air is of water vapour.

why.en: Like how full a sponge is, as a percent.
why.zh: 就像海绵有多满，用百分比表示。

questions.q: Dew on the grass in the morning is water vapour that...
options: came up out of the soil

why.en: Like drops on a cold drink: water vapour turns into drops on the cool grass.
why.zh: 就像冰饮料上的水珠：水蒸气在凉凉的草上变成水珠。

canNow.en: I can now explain air pressure, wind, station models and humidity.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释气压、风、气象站模型和湿度。

title.en: Saturday Homework: Pressure, Station Models and Humidity (W5 to W7)
title.zh: 星期六作业：气压、气象站模型和湿度（W5 到 W7）

intro.en: Look at your Main Book if you need to. One try only.
intro.zh: 需要的话看主课本。只能做一次。

questions.q: Under high pressure, the air...
options: sinks, and the sky is usually clear

why.en: Heavy cold air sinks and presses down: usually clear skies.
why.zh: 又重又冷的空气下沉：通常是晴天。

questions.q: Light, warm air rising makes...

why.en: Rising warm air = low pressure, usually clouds and rain.
why.zh: 上升的暖空气 = 低压，通常有云和雨。

questions.q: Air rushing out of a squeezed balloon is like wind blowing from...

why.en: Squeezed = high pressure inside. Air rushes out to lower pressure.
why.zh: 被挤 = 里面是高压。空气冲向低压的地方。

questions.q: Isobars close together mean...

why.en: Like close lines on a hill map: steep, so fast.
why.zh: 就像地形图上靠得近的线：陡，所以快。

questions.q: On a station model, the number on the RIGHT is the...

why.en: Right = air pressure (mb). Left = temperature.
why.zh: 右边 = 气压（mb）。左边 = 温度。

questions.q: On a station model, a circle that is all shaded means...
options: the sky is covered in cloud

why.en: More shaded = more cloud. All shaded = covered.
why.zh: 涂得越多 = 云越多。全部涂满 = 满天云。

questions.q: On a weather map, H and L stand for...

why.en: H = high pressure. L = low pressure.
why.zh: H = 高压。L = 低压。

questions.q: Humidity is...
options: how much water vapour is in the air
how hard the air pushes down

why.en: Humidity = water vapour in the air.
why.zh: 湿度 = 空气里的水蒸气。

questions.q: Relative humidity of 100% means...
options: the air is full, so rain or dew can form

why.en: 100% = completely full, so water starts to come out.
why.zh: 100% = 完全满了，所以水开始出来。

questions.q: The bottom of a cloud is where the air has cooled to its...

why.en: At the dew point, water vapour turns into drops, so the cloud starts there.
why.zh: 到了露点，水蒸气变成水珠，所以云从那里开始。

canNow.en: I can now read pressure, station models and humidity.
canNow.zh: 我现在会看气压、气象站模型和湿度。

title.en: Sunday Homework: Climate Factors and Zones (W8 and W9)
title.zh: 星期天作业：气候因素和气候带（W8 和 W9）

intro.en: Look at your Main Book if you need to. One try only.
intro.zh: 需要的话看主课本。只能做一次。

questions.q: Latitude tells how far a place is ___ of the equator.

why.en: Latitude = how far north or south, in degrees (°).
why.zh: 纬度 = 往北或往南多远，用度（°）表示。

questions.q: Near the equator it is hot because the sun...

why.en: Straight-down sunshine is strong. Near the poles the sun is low, so it is cold.
why.zh: 直射的阳光很强。靠近两极太阳很低，所以冷。

questions.q: Water warms up and cools down ___ than land.

why.en: Water changes temperature much more slowly than land.
why.zh: 水温度变化比陆地慢得多。

questions.q: Which city has milder (gentler) weather all year?

why.en: The ocean changes slowly, so the coast stays milder. San Diego: 24°C to 9°C. Phoenix: 41°C to 5°C.
why.zh: 海洋变化慢，所以海边更温和。San Diego：24°C 到 9°C。Phoenix：41°C 到 5°C。

questions.q: Wet air climbs a mountain, cools and drops its rain. The dry side behind the mountain is the...

why.en: The dry side gets very little rain: the rain shadow.
why.zh: 干燥的那一边几乎不下雨：雨影区。

questions.q: Global winds...
options: blow steadily in the same direction over large parts of Earth

why.en: Global winds are steady and cover large parts of Earth.
why.zh: 全球风带很稳定，覆盖地球的大片地区。

questions.q: The equator is at...

why.en: Equator = 0°.

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer is at...

why.en: Tropic of Cancer = 23.5°N. Tropic of Capricorn = 23.5°S.
why.zh: 北回归线 = 23.5°N。南回归线 = 23.5°S。

questions.q: Which climate zone is cold and dry, inside the Arctic and Antarctic Circles?

why.en: Polar = inside the polar circles: cold and dry.
why.zh: 极地 = 在极圈里面：又冷又干。

questions.q: A big area with its own climate, plants and animals is a...

why.en: Biome = a big area with its own climate, plants and animals.
why.zh: 生物群系 = 有自己气候、植物和动物的一大片地区。

canNow.en: I can now explain climate factors, climate zones and biomes.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释气候因素、气候带和生物群系。
